name: io.github.zmarten/meatspace
title: MeatSpace
description: Human approval for AI agents via magic link. Pause your agent; a human decides; webhook back.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token for the ask_human tool. Optional — get_service_status and provision_api_key require no auth, so a fresh client can connect without credentials and call provision_api_key to mint a token instantly.

api_key.description: Your MeatSpace API key. Mint one with provision_api_key (no auth, rate-limited to 5 keys per email) or via POST https://meatspace.run/api/keys.

useCases: Pause an AI agent before destructive tool calls (file deletion, SQL drops, force-push)
Route subjective decisions (taste, copy choice, image selection) to a human
Add human review to autonomous coding agents before merging or deploying
Approve agent-initiated emails, payments, or external communications

exampleTools.name: provision_api_key
exampleTools.description: Mint a Bearer token. Rate-limited to 5 keys per email per hour.

exampleTools.name: ask_human

input.title: Delete production database?
input.content: Agent wants to run: DROP TABLE users;

exampleTools.description: Submit a 2-4 choice question to a human. Long-polls up to 25s; use callback_url for longer waits.
